commit1Lines.text: 🛡️ Caleb, Quinn, David step forward. They will march with the muster, eat from your stores (1000 kcal/day each), and stand in front of THE HERALD. They can die — Haven does not get them back, and the fire will be quieter. Tap again — Haven sends its own.

commit2Lines.text: 🛡️ Haven commits its own: Caleb, Quinn, David march with the muster. Not loaned. Not asked-for. Ours. The coalition counts 10 blades against THE HERALD — it needs 10.
